title: The geometric stalk of a sheafification is the stalk of the presheaf
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $T_{\Et}$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and $\bar t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], with category of pointed etale neighbourhoods $\mathcal N_{\bar t}$ [def-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-neighbourhoods]. For a presheaf of abelian groups $\mathcal F$ on $T_{\Et}$ (a contravariant functor from $T_{\Et}$ to abelian groups) define its stalk $\mathcal F_{\bar t}=\varinjlim_{(U,\bar u)\in\mathcal N_{\bar t}^{\mathrm{op}}}\mathcal F(U)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], with coprojections $s\mapsto(\text{class of }s\text{ at }(U,\bar u))$ (for a sheaf this is the stalk of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]). Let $\theta:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F^\#$ be the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], $\mathcal F^\#\in\Ab(T_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Then the homomorphism $\theta_{\bar t}:\mathcal F_{\bar t}\to(\mathcal F^\#)_{\bar t}$ induced by $\theta$, sending the class of $s\in\mathcal F(U)$ at $(U,\bar u)$ to the class of $\theta_U(s)$ at $(U,\bar u)$, is an isomorphism of abelian groups.

source.place: Lemma 03PT (2) (lemma-stalk-exact: $(\mathcal F^\#)_{\bar s}=\mathcal F_{\bar s}$; the proof there shows injectivity of $\kappa:\mathcal F_{\bar s}\to(\mathcal F^\#)_{\bar s}$ and omits surjectivity), with Definition 040R; complete proof via Lemma 04FM (lemma-stalk-gives-point: the stalk comes from a point of $S_{\Et}$) and literature/stacks-project/sites.tex Lemma 00Y8 (3) (lemma-point-pushforward-sheaf: $\mathcal F_p=\mathcal F^\#_p$ by the adjunctions of stalk/skyscraper and of sheafification)

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: take Φ = AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.pointSmallEtale t̄ (Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/EtalePoint.lean:64; Ω algebraically closed is separably closed, instance IsAlgClosed → IsSepClosed) and A = AddCommGrpCat.{u} for T : Scheme.{u} (HasProducts and HasColimitsOfSize.{u,u}; HasWeakSheafify from AffineEtale.lean:112). The component at a presheaf P of `presheafToSheafCompSheafFiberIso A` (line 282) is `asIso (Φ.presheafFiber.map (toSheafify J P))` (equivalently the instance at lines 273-275), i.e. the node's θ_{t̄}. `Φ.presheafFiber.obj P` is the colimit of P over (Φ.fiber.Elements)ᵒᵖ (Point/Basic.lean:96), and for pointSmallEtale the category of elements is N_{t̄} (an element of fiber X is a morphism Spec Ω ⟶ X.left over T), the identification recorded in lem-weil-pbc-pointed-etale-neighbourhoods-cofiltered; sheafFiber is presheafFiber of the underlying presheaf (Basic.lean:277), so this is the node's stalk.
